title: Global Convergence of Second-Order Methods for Physics-Informed Neural Networks in the Overparameterized Limit
abstract: arXiv:2611.34452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) constitutes a core task in many engineering and scientific disciplines. Physics-informed neural networks and the deep Galerkin method effectively leverage machine learning models to approximate solutions of known PDEs by minimizing residuals corresponding to the PDE operator alongside external constraints. Although second-order optimizers are becoming increasingly popular for training neural networks (NNs) to solve PDEs and empirically outperform their first-order counterparts in both speed and accuracy, the convergence theory for training such models is essentially confined to first-order methods. In this paper, we close this gap and develop a convergence analysis for the regularized Newton and Gauss-Newton methods. As the number of hidden units tends to infinity, the training dynamics converge in probability, with explicit rates, to the solution of a deterministic limit e

translated_title: 过参数化极限下物理信息神经网络二阶优化方法的全局收敛性
translated_abstract: 求解高维偏微分方程（PDEs）是许多工程与科学领域的核心任务。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和深度Galerkin方法通过最小化与PDE算子对应的残差以及外部约束，有效地利用机器学习模型来逼近已知PDE的解。尽管二阶优化器在训练神经网络求解PDE方面日益流行，并在速度和精度上都优于其一阶方法，但训练此类模型的收敛理论基本仅限于一阶方法。在本文中，我们填补了这一空白，为正则化牛顿法和Gauss-牛顿法建立了收敛性分析。当隐藏单元数量趋于无穷时，训练动力学以概率收敛（并具有显式收敛速率）到某个确定性极限方程的解。
tldr: 本文首次为物理信息神经网络训练中的正则化牛顿法和Gauss-牛顿法建立了全局收敛理论，证明了在过参数化极限下训练动力学以显式速率概率收敛到确定性极限方程的解。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first global convergence theory for regularized Newton and Gauss-Newton methods in training physics-informed neural networks, proving that in the overparameterized limit, the training dynamics converge in probability with explicit rates to the solution of a deterministic limit equation.
